about_the_game:
An immersive gothic soundscape by Jeffrey Montoya with special guest track from legendary composer Óscar Araujo.

Step into the cursed lands of Gévaudan through the haunting melodies of the Chronicles of the Wolf original soundtrack. Crafted by Jeffrey Montoya, the game’s principal composer, this collection blends eerie ambience, sweeping orchestration and driving retro rhythms to mirror every twist of Mateo Lombardo’s perilous journey.

From tense boss battles to the chilling calm of long-forgotten ruins, each track reflects a world where myth bleeds into history.

Adding a powerful touch of legacy, the soundtrack also features a special guest composition by Óscar Araujo, best known for his work on Castlevania: Lords of Shadow—bringing even deeper resonance for fans of the genre.

Whether you’re returning from battle or wandering shadowed hallways, this OST invites you to relive the legend long after the hunt ends.

Composers:

• Jeffrey Montoya – Lead Composer

• Óscar Araujo – Guest Composer (Castlevania: Lords of Shadow)

Let the music of the Wolf guide you…
